columns.name: origin_dc
columns.reason: Origin distribution center is fixed when the load is booked and dispatched.

columns.name: grower_lot
columns.reason: Lot identifier is assigned at packing, before the shipment moves.

columns.name: insurer_code
columns.reason: Could be a booking-time policy field or only populated when a spoilage claim is opened.

columns.name: claims_office
columns.reason: A claims office is assigned only once a loss claim is filed, which follows spoilage.

columns.name: dest_dc
columns.reason: Destination facility is known at booking.

columns.name: appointment_band
columns.reason: The delivery appointment window is scheduled before the load departs.

columns.name: ambient_route_temp_q4
columns.reason: Reads as measured ambient exposure over the last quarter of transit, final only at delivery.

columns.name: disposal_ticket_usd
columns.reason: A disposal charge exists only after product has been condemned.

columns.name: reefer_setpoint_c
columns.reason: The setpoint is programmed when the trailer is loaded.

columns.name: temp_probe_model
columns.reason: Attribute of the probe hardware fitted before departure.

columns.name: pack_size
columns.reason: Packing specification is known from the order at loading.

columns.name: handling_unit_type
columns.reason: The handling unit is chosen when the load is built.

columns.name: route_distance_km
columns.reason: Planned lane distance comes from the load plan at dispatch.

columns.name: yard_slot
columns.reason: Reads as the yard position assigned during loading, though a destination-yard reading would come later.

columns.name: door_open_events
columns.reason: The door-opening count accumulates through transit and is final only at delivery.

columns.name: ambient_route_temp_q3
columns.reason: Reads as measured ambient exposure over a quarter of transit, not complete at dispatch.

columns.name: calibration_lot
columns.reason: Calibration lot is a property of the probe installed before shipping.

columns.name: invoice_terms
columns.reason: Payment terms come from the customer contract at booking rather than the later invoice.

columns.name: ambient_route_temp_q2
columns.reason: Reads as measured ambient exposure over a quarter of transit, not complete at dispatch.

columns.name: driver_team_flag
columns.reason: Team-driver staffing is decided when the load is tendered.

columns.name: commodity_code
columns.reason: Commodity is known from the order before shipping.

columns.name: load_plan_ver
columns.reason: The load plan version is fixed once the trailer is loaded.

columns.name: trailer_class
columns.reason: Trailer type is known at dispatch.

columns.name: carrier_scac
columns.reason: The carrier is assigned when the load is tendered.

columns.name: seal_number_prefix
columns.reason: The seal is applied at loading.

columns.name: logger_download_max_c
columns.reason: Peak temperature is obtained only when the data logger is downloaded at receiving.

columns.name: ambient_route_temp_q1
columns.reason: Reads as measured ambient exposure over a quarter of transit, not complete at dispatch.

columns.name: route_variant
columns.reason: The routing option is chosen when the trip is planned.

columns.name: case_gtin_prefix
columns.reason: Case identifier is set at packing.

columns.name: booking_channel
columns.reason: Recorded when the order is booked.

columns.name: inspection_desk
columns.reason: The inspecting desk is recorded only when the load is checked at destination.

columns.name: pallet_wrap_type
columns.reason: Wrap material is applied at pallet build.

columns.name: post_arrival_hold_hours
columns.reason: Hold time accrues after the shipment has arrived.

columns.name: palletiser_line
columns.reason: The packing line used is known at origin.

columns.name: depot_region
columns.reason: Static attribute of the originating depot.

columns.name: toll_zone
columns.reason: Derived from the planned route at dispatch.

columns.name: stack_limit_code
columns.reason: Packaging stack spec is known when the pallet is built.

columns.name: fuel_card_zone
columns.reason: Reads as a carrier or lane administrative attribute set at tender.

columns.name: qa_excursion_severity_score
columns.reason: QA scores the excursion after the load is received and reviewed.

columns.name: gate_in_shift
columns.reason: Cannot tell whether this is the origin gate-in before dispatch or the destination gate-in after transit.

columns.name: arrival_pulp_temp_c
columns.reason: Pulp temperature is measured on arrival at the destination.

columns.name: qa_hold_code_applied
columns.reason: A QA hold code is applied only after receiving inspection.

columns.name: precool_hours
columns.reason: Precooling is completed before the trailer is loaded.

columns.name: pallet_height_cm
columns.reason: Measured when the pallet is built at origin.

columns.name: customs_regime
columns.reason: Declared as part of the booking paperwork.

columns.name: label_stock
columns.reason: Label material is chosen at packing.

columns.name: reefer_unit_id
columns.reason: The reefer asset is assigned when the load is dispatched.
